scope: Read-only remote review, complete path/size inventory and selected text inspection; no clone, Unity import, compilation or gameplay execution.

inventory.important_size_limit: GitHub repository size, checkout payload, Unity Library, installed Editor, package cache and final build are different quantities.

findings.title: The intended game is not implemented in the project scenes
findings.observation: Both project scenes contain only Main Camera and Directional Light, with no MonoBehaviour or prefab-instance blocks. No scripts exist beneath Assets/0_ProjectData in the complete tree.
findings.impact: There is no implemented driving/mining/cargo/selling/upgrade/save loop in those scenes to review or play.
findings.action: Treat this as setup completed and gameplay not started. Build one minimal vertical slice before expanding assets.

findings.title: Public source includes vendor asset packages
findings.observation: Repository is public and contains raw vendor source/assets. Separate rights to redistribute these files were not established.
findings.impact: A game-use license may not authorize public source redistribution.
findings.action: Verify each applicable license and source-distribution permission. Consider private collaboration or an original-code-only public repository. Do not change visibility or rewrite history as part of this review.

findings.title: Default build scene list points only to SampleScene
findings.observation: Only Assets/Scenes/SampleScene.unity is enabled. No committed BuildProfile assets were found in the tree.
findings.impact: A build using the committed default list will not start the intended game scene.
findings.action: After implementing the slice, set the intended entry scene in Build Profiles/scene list and test a standalone launch.

findings.title: Bundled example controller uses legacy input under new-input-only settings
findings.observation: activeInputHandler is 1; ExamplePlayer calls UnityEngine.Input.GetMouseButtonDown and GetKeyDown/GetKeyUp without a legacy-backend guard.
findings.impact: Reusing/enabling that example with the current backend can raise invalid input-operation errors. It is not attached in the empty project scenes.
findings.action: Use Input System actions in the new vehicle controller. If a legacy demo must run, test an explicit compatibility choice instead of assuming the example works.

findings.title: Repository proposal differs materially from the earlier handoff
findings.observation: The planning note still describes an empty non-Unity workspace and proposes two materials, 15-capacity cargo, optional upgrades, bridge rebuilding and Power Push. The earlier brief uses one material, 8-capacity cargo, a mandatory single drill upgrade and a delivery beacon.
findings.impact: An implementation agent can combine incompatible economy, completion and full-cargo rules.
findings.action: Write one current authoritative Sprint 1 spec using the latest human-approved direction; label the other proposal historical. Preserve unresolved product choices instead of silently combining them.

findings.title: Asset-library footprint dominates the checkout
findings.observation: 1,045,523,843 bytes of tracked current-tree content; the two named folders total 951,110,237 bytes (90.97%).
findings.impact: Importing the entire library creates storage and processing costs before the first playable loop exists.
findings.action: Prepare a small dependency-complete prototype checkout or branch, retaining required .meta files and licenses. Review demo dependencies before exclusions. No files were removed during this review.
